key_findings: Novel alkaloid HJ-69 from Zanthoxylum bungeanum state-dependently inhibits Nav currents (IC50 13.06 uM inactivated, 30.19 uM resting) and IK in DRG neurons.
HJ-69 (30 and 100 mg/kg i.p.) alleviated formalin-induced inflammatory pain in mice.
